name: svg-eli5-archify
title_zh: 代码库自带 ELI5 分层图解
tagline_zh: 面对陌生仓库不再头皮发麻。它用 ELI5 类比拆解每一层依赖，输出带证据的 SVG 架构图，评审汇报直接贴。
tagline_en: Facing an unfamiliar repo? It dissects layers with simple analogies and outputs an evidence-backed SVG.
desc_en: Analyze a codebase or infrastructure repository and produce an evidence-backed, SVG-first one-page architecture explainer using simple ELI5 analogies and layered system mapping. Use for requests to understand, review, or present a repository or deployed system visually; do not use for generic charts, implementation-only work, or text-only summaries.
why_zh: 不是画流程图，是逐层拆解系统并标注证据来源，让架构图经得起追问。类比先行，技术细节随后，认知负担骤降。
why_en: It doesn't just draw boxes—it maps each layer to source evidence, so the diagram survives scrutiny. Analogies first, details.
limit_zh: 只处理代码库或基础设施仓库，不画通用图表；产物是 SVG 架构图，不含实施建议或代码修改；需要仓库可读且依赖关系清晰。
limit_en: Only for code/infra repos, not generic charts. Output is an SVG map only—no implementation advice. Needs readable deps; broken links stall the.
title_en: ELI5 layered architecture diagrams for any codebase
